title: The New Shape of Search: How Conversational AI Recomposes Information Seeking
abstract: arXiv:2607.04282v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The familiar search journey begins with a query and moves outward into documents, and conversational AI is commonly imagined at its mouth: ask first, then click out. Linking captured prompts and responses to the same panelists' observed searches and pageviews, and reconstructing inactivity-defined cross-surface temporal sessions (standalone assistant surfaces; search-embedded AI such as AI Overviews and AI Mode is out of scope, since it co-occurs with the results page), we find the observed journeys more often run the other way. Content usually follows search but more often precedes assistant use. Within the same panelist, the paired difference-of-directions between the two anchors is +20.6 [19.9, 21.3] percentage points; it persists within every coarse destination-domain stratum we can observe (semantic task and task-stage matching remain unresolved), and every headline result replicates in a second, adjacent month. translated_title: 搜索的新形态：对话式AI如何重构信息寻求过程
translated_abstract: 摘要：熟悉的搜索旅程始于查询，然后向外扩展到文档，而对话式AI通常被想象在其入口处：先提问，然后点击出去。通过将捕获的提示和响应与同一小组成员的观察到的搜索和页面浏览相关联，并重建由非活动定义的跨表面时间会话（独立的助手表面；搜索嵌入的AI如AI概览和AI模式不在范围内，因为它们与结果页面同时出现），我们发现观察到的旅程往往以相反的方式运行。内容通常跟随搜索，但更常先于助手使用。在同一小组成员中，两个锚点之间的方向配对差异为+20.6 [19.9, 21.3]个百分点；这一差异在我们能观察到的每个粗略目的地域层中持续存在（语义任务和任务阶段匹配仍未解决），并且每个头条结果在相邻的第二个月中重复出现。搜索十
tldr: 这项研究通过分析用户行为数据发现，对话式AI的使用通常先于搜索内容，而非传统认为的搜索在前，揭示了信息寻求过程的新模式。
en_tdlr: This study, through analyzing user behavior data, finds that conversational AI usage typically precedes search content, rather than the traditional assumption of search first, revealing a new pattern in information seeking processes.
